handoffs.rationale: TENT-731 satisfies all mandate requirements: price $69 (under $100 limit), independent durability certificate CERT-7318 with quality_score 4.8 (exceeds 4.0 minimum), and verified-purchase reviews confirming exceptional durability for 4P use. TENT-284's certificate (CERT-4107) explicitly does not cover the 4P configuration sold and is under review for scope limitations, making it unsuitable despite lower price. TENT-731 offers superior independent evidence and verified field performance.
